sources.title: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.NthRootLemmas
sources.enterprise_use: Directly reuses Nat.nthRoot and its power/root Galois-connection lemmas in the pinned Lean formalization of Enterprise Math integer roots, collapse, exponent composition and fixed points.
sources.not_claimed: Nat.nthRoot and its formal order/root lemmas are established mathlib work. Mathlib may describe nthRoot through a floor-of-real-root implementation or theorem context; Enterprise Math does not adopt a hidden real root as its internal primitive ontology.

sources.title: Mathlib.Order.GaloisConnection.Basic
sources.enterprise_use: Directly reuses generic GaloisConnection/Galois insertion-co-insertion theory and commuting-adjoint APIs, including the structure used to transport the power/multiplication commuting square into root/floor-division interchange.
sources.not_claimed: Galois connections, insertions/coinsertions, adjoint composition and commuting-adjoint transport are established order theory and mathlib formalization, not Enterprise Math inventions.
